描述

HunyuanImage 2.1 图像到图像工作流程

此 ComfyUI 工作流程专为浑源Image 2.1并允许您将普通照片转换为高质量的艺术图像，同时保留原始构图。

它经过优化，可以从单个源图像创建各种视觉样式，包括：

  • 奇幻风景

  • 赛博朋克环境

  • 动漫风格的风景

  • 概念艺术

  • 风格化插图

只需加载您的图像，调整提示，然后生成一个全新的世界。

特点

  • 针对HunyuanImage 2.1进行了优化

  • 图像到图像工作流程

  • 易于使用

  • 支持多种艺术风格

  • 保留原始图像的构图

  • 适用于风景、建筑、环境场景

推荐设置

  • 步骤：24-28日

  • CFG 规模：5.5–6.5

  • 采样器：欧拉

  • 调度程序：简单

  • 降噪：0.55–0.75

这些设置可以根据您想要的风格进行调整。

注释

该工作流程主要使用风景照片进行测试。

请随意修改提示和设置来创建您自己独特的世界。

如果您发现此工作流程有用，请考虑留下评分。非常感谢您的反馈！

享受创作的乐趣！

使用 HunyuanImage 2.1 将现实世界的照片转变为富有想象力的世界。

- hunyuanimage2.1_bf16.safetensors

文本编码器

ComfyUI/模型/text_encoders/

- qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors

- byt5_small_glyphbf16.safetensors

VAE

ComfyUI/模型/vae/

- hunyuan_image_2.1_vae_fp16.safetensors

Description

HunyuanImage 2.1 Image-to-Image Workflow

This ComfyUI workflow is designed forHunyuanImage 2.1and allows you to transform ordinary photographs into high-quality artistic images while preserving the original composition.

It is optimized for creating a wide variety of visual styles from a single source image, including:

  • Fantasy landscapes

  • Cyberpunk environments

  • Anime-style scenery

  • Concept art

  • Stylized illustrations

Simply load your image, adjust the prompt, and generate a completely new world.

Features

  • Optimized for HunyuanImage 2.1

  • Image-to-Image workflow

  • Easy to use

  • Supports various artistic styles

  • Preserves the composition of the original image

  • Suitable for landscapes, architecture, and environmental scenes

Recommended Settings

  • Steps:24–28

  • CFG Scale:5.5–6.5

  • Sampler:Euler

  • Scheduler:Simple

  • Denoise:0.55–0.75

These settings may be adjusted depending on your desired style.

Notes

This workflow was tested primarily with landscape photographs.

Feel free to modify the prompts and settings to create your own unique worlds.

If you find this workflow useful, please consider leaving a rating. Your feedback is greatly appreciated!

Enjoy creating!

Transform real-world photos into imaginative worlds with HunyuanImage 2.1.

## Required Models

Place the following files in your ComfyUI model folders.

Checkpoint

ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/

- hunyuanimage2.1_bf16.safetensors

Text Encoders

ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/

- qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors

- byt5_small_glyphbf16.safetensors

VAE

ComfyUI/models/vae/

- hunyuan_image_2.1_vae_fp16.safetensors

This workflow requires the official HunyuanImage 2.1 model files.

Please download them from the official repository.
